description: KNa₂BO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.79 Å) and two longer (2.80 Å) K-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are three shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.38 Å) and two longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, four equivalent Na, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and one B atom.
